about: Festival status engine calendar, 11 Nov 2026 - 31 Mar 2027 (scripts/status-engine.mjs, scripts/day-plan.mjs). Every date was checked on 11 Nov 2026 (Feb-Mar 2027 rows on 20 Nov 2026) for New Delhi in two panchang sources (D = drikpanchang.com, Smarta, Purnimanta; P = prokerala.com with loc=1261481 = New Delhi); the second source is named where prokerala has no page. tier big = 3 status variants (evening before 20:00, 00:30, 07:30 = statusday, 08:30 until 20 Nov 2026; Janmotsav 4), status = 2 (evening before 20:00, 00:30), info = in the calendar for the story writer only (no status Short). names: one per variant in time order, or the variant's own `name` (title English first: 'Happy <en> Status <year> ✨ | <hi> स्टेटस वीडियो #Shorts' for a celebratory festival, '<en> Status <year> 🙏 | <hi> स्टेटस वीडियो #Shorts' for a vrat / solemn tithi; `happy` true/false overrides status-themes HAPPY_THEMES). small: true = a small monthly tithi (Pradosh, Masik Shivratri, Sankashti, plain Amavasya / Purnima vrat) with only the 00:30 variant. season: true = a festival people keep on their status for days (Khatu Phalgun mela, Mahashivratri, Holi; when the calendar is extended: Khatu Janmotsav 2027, Diwali 2027, Hanuman Janmotsav 2027): countdown `status` variants (negative offset, own `name` and `hook`) from 8-14 days before (competitor decode automation/competitor-decode-2026-11.md section 5: 8-14 days ahead 1.28x; Janmotsav 2026 competitors 12, 7, 6, 4 days ahead), each replacing that day's weekday day status (scripts/day-plan.mjs). theme: scripts/status-themes.mjs; spec: a hand-written base spec that replaces the theme. automation/calendar.md is generated from this file (node scripts/status-engine.mjs calendar).

sources.P: https://www.prokerala.com (?loc=1261481 = New Delhi; month grid /general/calendar/hinducalendar.php?year=YYYY&mon=<month>&sb=1&loc=1261481; festival pages /festivals/<slug>.html?loc=1261481)
sources.T: https://www.timeanddate.com/holidays/india/holi (third source for Holi 2027, where D and P differ)
sources.K: https://www.khatu.org (Khatu Shyam Phalgun mela parampara) and https://www.thedailyjagran.com (Khatu Shyam Falgun Mela 2026 dates)

excluded: Guru Nanak Jayanti (24 Nov 2026, D + P): another faith's festival, not used for status Shorts on this devotional channel.
Papmochani Ekadashi 2027 = Fri 2 Apr 2027 (D): after 31 Mar, not in this window. Chaitra Navratri / Ram Navami 2027: April.
Phulera Dooj 10 Mar, Ratha Saptami 13 Feb, Ranga Panchami 27 Mar 2027: D only (P does not list them), no status Short.
Holi Bhai Dooj 24 Mar 2027 (D): not a status Short (Bhai Dooj of Kartik is the searched one).
